entries.title: EXILED framework overview
entries.text: EXILED (version 9.15.2) is a community plugin framework for SCP: Secret Laboratory servers, made by the ExMod Team. Plugins inherit `Plugin<Config>` (Exiled.API.Features) with a config class implementing `IConfig` (IsEnabled, Debug). Subscribe to events in OnEnabled() with `Exiled.Events.Handlers.<Category>.<Event> += handler;` and unsubscribe in OnDisabled(). Events whose args implement IDeniableEvent can be cancelled with `ev.IsAllowed = false`. Commands use the game's CommandSystem: `[CommandHandler(typeof(RemoteAdminCommandHandler))]` on a class implementing `ICommand`. Event categories: Cassie, Item, Map, Player, Scp049, Scp0492, Scp079, Scp096, Scp106, Scp127, Scp1344, Scp1507, Scp1509, Scp173, Scp244, Scp2536, Scp3114, Scp330, Scp559, Scp914, Scp939, Server, Warhead.

entries.title: EXILED event: Cassie.SendingCassieMessage
entries.text:
Invoked before sending a cassie message.
It can be cancelled: set `ev.IsAllowed = false;`.
`ev` (SendingCassieMessageEventArgs) contains:
- `string Words` (can be changed): Gets or sets the message.
- `string CustomSubtitles` (can be changed): Gets or sets the message subtitles.
- `bool MakeHold` (can be changed): Gets or sets a value indicating whether the message should be held.
- `float GlitchScale` (can be changed): Gets or sets a value controlling how glitchy this CASSIE message is.
- `bool MakeNoise` (can be changed): Gets or sets a value indicating whether the message should make noise.
- `bool IsAllowed` (can be changed): Gets or sets a value indicating whether the message can be sent.
- `bool IsCustomAnnouncement` (can be changed): Gets or sets a value indicating whether the event can be executed.
- `CassieTtsPayload.SubtitleMode SubtitleSource` (can be changed): Gets or sets a value indicating where the subtitles for this message came from.
- `CassieAnnouncement Announcement`: Gets a CassieAnnouncement consisting of all properties in this event.

entries.title: EXILED event: Item.ChangingAmmo

- `bool IsAllowed` (can be changed): Gets or sets a value indicating whether the ammo can be changed.

- `Item Create(ItemType type, Player owner = null)`: Creates a new Item with the proper inherited subclass. Based on the type, the returned Item can be casted into a subclass to gain more control over the object. - Usable items (Adrenaline, Medkit, Painkillers, SCP-207, SCP-268, and SCP-500) should be casted to the Usable class. - All valid ammo should be casted to the Ammo class. - All valid firearms (not including the Micro HID) should be casted to the Firearm class. - All valid keycards should be casted to the Keycard class. - All valid armor should be casted to the Armor class. - Explosive grenades and SCP-018 should be casted to the ExplosiveGrenade class. - Flash grenades should be casted to the FlashGrenade class. The following have their own respective classes: - Flashlights can be casted to Flashlight. - Radios can be casted to Radio. - The Micro HID can be casted to MicroHid. - SCP-244 A and B variants can be casted to Scp244. - SCP-330 can be casted to Scp330. - SCP-2176 can be casted to the Scp2176 class. - SCP-1576 can be casted to the Scp1576 class. - SCP-1344 can be casted to the Scp1344 class. - Jailbird can be casted to the Jailbird class. Items that are not listed above do not have a subclass, and can only use the base Item class.
- `T Create<T>(ItemType type, Player owner = null)`: Creates a new Item with the proper inherited subclass. Based on the type, the returned Item can be casted into a subclass to gain more control over the object. - Usable items (Adrenaline, Medkit, Painkillers, SCP-207, SCP-268, and SCP-500) should be casted to the Usable class. - All valid ammo should be casted to the Ammo class. - All valid firearms (not including the Micro HID) should be casted to the Firearm class. - All valid keycards should be casted to the Keycard class. - All valid armor should be casted to the Armor class. - Explosive grenades and SCP-018 should be casted to the ExplosiveGrenade class. - Flash grenades should be casted to the FlashGrenade class. The following have their own respective classes: - Flashlights can be casted to Flashlight. - Radios can be casted to Radio. - The Micro HID can be casted to MicroHid. - SCP-244 A and B variants can be casted to Scp244. - SCP-330 can be casted to Scp330. - SCP-2176 can be casted to the Scp2176 class. - SCP-1576 can be casted to the Scp1576 class. - SCP-1344 can be casted to the Scp1344 class. - Jailbird can be casted to the Jailbird class. - `Role Role`: Gets a Role that is unique to this player and this class. This allows modification of various aspects related to the role solely. The type of the Role is different based on the RoleTypeId of the player, and casting should be used to modify the role. Spectator = SpectatorRole. Overwatch = OverwatchRole. None = NoneRole. Scp049 = Scp049Role. Scp0492 = Scp0492Role. Scp079 = Scp079Role. Scp096 = Scp096Role. Scp106 = Scp106Role. Scp173 = Scp173Role. Scp3114 = Scp3114Role. Scp939 = Scp939Role. If not listed above, the type of Role will be HumanRole. If the role object is stored, it may become invalid if the player changes roles. Thus, the IsValid property can be checked. If this property is false, the role should be discarded and this property should be used again to get the new Role. This role is automatically cached until it changes, and it is recommended to use this property directly rather than storing the property yourself. Roles and RoleTypeIds can be compared directly. Player.Role == RoleTypeId.Scp079 is valid and will return true if the player is SCP-079. To set the player's role, see Set.

- `Dictionary<string, object> SessionVariables`: Gets the dictionary of the server's session variables. Session variables can be used to save temporary data. Data is stored in a Dictionary. The key of the data is always a string, whereas the value can be any object. The data stored in a session variable can be accessed by different assemblies; it is recommended to uniquely identify stored data so that it does not conflict with other plugins that may also be using the same name. Data saved with session variables is not being saved on server restart. If the data must be saved after a restart, a database must be used instead.
- `void Restart()`: Restarts the server, reconnects all players.
- `void Restart(bool fastRestart, bool overrideRestartAction = false, ServerStatic.NextRoundAction restartAction = ServerStatic.NextRoundAction.DoNothing)`: Restarts the server with specified options.

entries.title: EXILED API: EffectType (part 1 of 3)
entries.text:
enum `Exiled.API.Enums.EffectType`: Status effects as enum.
Values:
- `None`: This EffectType do not exist it's only use when not found or error.
- `AmnesiaItems`: Prevents the affected player from reloading weapons and using medical items.
- `AmnesiaVision`: Makes SCP-939 invisible to players under its effect. Visibility is temporarily restored when SCP-939 takes damage or attacks.
- `Asphyxiated`: Drains the affected player's stamina and then health.
- `Bleeding`: Damages the affected player over time.
- `Blinded`: Blurs the affected player's screen.
- `Burned`: Increases damage the affected player receives. Does not apply any standalone damage.
- `Concussed`: Blurs the affected player's screen while rotating.
- `Corroding`: Effect given to the affected player after being hurt by SCP-106.
- `Deafened`: Muffles the affected player's audio. Does not scale with intensity.
- `Decontaminating`: Removes 10% of the affected player's health per second.
- `Disabled`: Slows down the affected player's movement.
- `Ensnared`: Prevents the affected player from moving.
- `Exhausted`: Halves the affected player's maximum stamina and stamina regeneration rate.
- `Flashed`: Flashes the affected player.
- `Hemorrhage`: Drains the affected player's health while sprinting.
- `Invigorated`: Increases the affected player's FOV very slightly, gives infinite stamina and gives the effect of underwater sound.
- `BodyshotReduction`: Reduces the affected player's damage taken by body shots.
- `Poisoned`: Damages the affected player every 5 seconds, starting low and increasing over time, capping out at 20 hp every 5 seconds.
- `Scp207`: Increases the speed of the affected player while also draining health, dependent on how fast the player is moving.
- `Invisible`: Makes the affected player invisible.
- `SinkHole`: Slows the affected player's movement speed, adds vignette, and makes the affected player's footsteps the same as SCP106's.
- `DamageReduction`: Reduces the affected player's overall damage taken.
- `MovementBoost`: Increases the affected player's movement speed.
- `RainbowTaste`: Reduces the severity of the affected player's negative effects.

entries.title: EXILED API: EffectType (part 2 of 3)
entries.text:
enum `Exiled.API.Enums.EffectType`: Status effects as enum.
Values:
- `SeveredHands`: Drops the affected player's current item, disables interaction with objects, spawns hands that drop to the floor, and deals damage while effect is active.
- `Stained`: Prevents the affected player from sprinting, plays a sound alongside their every footstep, reduces movement speed by 20%.
- `Vitality`: Causes the affected player to gain immunity to certain negative status effects.
- `Hypothermia`: Cause the affected player to slowly take damage, reduces bullet accuracy, applies a blue vignette, plays a sound effect spanning the entire effect's length, and increases item pickup time.
- `Scp1853`: Increases the affected player's motor function, causing the affected player to reduce the weapon draw time, reload speed, item pickup speed, and medical item usage.
- `CardiacArrest`: Effect given to a player after being hurt by SCP-049. Deals 8 damage per second, after an initial 16 damage for the first second.
- `InsufficientLighting`: Cause the lighting in the facility to dim heavily for the player.
- `SoundtrackMute`: Disable ambient sound.
- `SpawnProtected`: Protects the affected player from enemy damage if the config is enabled.
- `Traumatized`: All players with the Scp106 role will be able to see the affected player whilst stalking. Causes the affected player's screens to become monochromatic when seeing Scp106. The affected player is instantly killed if attacked by Scp106.
- `AntiScp207`: Slows the affected player, provides passive health regeneration and passive AHP gain up to 75, and can save the affected player from fatal damage once per effect.
- `Scanned`: The effect applied by SCP-079's breach scanner. Mutes the affected player's soundtrack.
- `PocketCorroding`: Teleports the affected player to the pocket dimension and drains their health until the affected player escapes the pocket dimension or is killed. The amount of damage received increases the longer the effect is applied.
- `SilentWalk`: Reduces the affected player's own movement sounds by 10% per intensity level.
- `Marshmallow`: Makes you a marshmallow guy.
- `Strangled`: The effect that is given to the player while getting attacked by SCP-3114's Strangle ability.
- `Ghostly`: Allows the affected player to pass through doors.
- `FogControl`: Manipulate which fog type the affected player will have. You can choose fog with FogType and putting it on intensity.
- `Slowness`: Slows the affected player down by 1% per intensity.
- `Scp1344`: Allows the affected player to see other players through walls, with a slight delay between spurts of viewability.
- `SeveredEyes`: Does not blind the affected player. Spawns eyeballs that drop to the floor, and does 10 damage per second.
- `PitDeath`: Immediately kills the affected player with death message "Fatal blunt trauma; the body is badly mutilated and pupled.", and "Reason: Crushed" through console.
- `Blurred`: Blurs the affected player's vision. Does not scale with intensity.
- `BecomingFlamingo`: Makes the affected player a flamingo BecomingFlamingo.
- `Scp559`: Makes the affected player a Child after eating Cake Scp559Effect.

entries.title: EXILED API: EffectType (part 3 of 3)
entries.text:
enum `Exiled.API.Enums.EffectType`: Status effects as enum.
Values:
- `Scp956Target`: Scp956 found you global::Scp956Target.
- `Snowed`: you are snowed global::Snowed.
- `Scp1344Detected`: Plays a sound effect to the affected player, and adds purple vignette to the affected player's vision.
- `Scp1576`: Allows the affected player to speak with players in spectator or overwatch.
- `Lightweight`: Increases the affected player's jump height.
- `HeavyFooted`: Decreases the affected player's jump height.
- `Fade`: Makes the affected player transparent, 255 being completely transparent.
- `NightVision`: Allows the affected player to see in dark areas. Does not extend the viewing range. Scales with intensity.
- `Metal`: Metal.
- `OrangeCandy`: OrangeCandy.
- `OrangeWitness`: OrangeWitness.
- `Prismatic`: Prismatic.
- `SlowMetabolism`: SlowMetabolism.
- `Spicy`: Spicy.
- `SugarCrave`: SugarCrave.
- `SugarHigh`: SugarHigh.
- `SugarRush`: SugarRush.
- `TemporaryBypass`: TemporaryBypass.
- `TraumatizedByEvil`: TraumatizedByEvil.
- `WhiteCandy`: WhiteCandy.
- `Scp1509Resurrected`: Gives the affected player 25 non-decaying AHP, and sets their HP to 75 if it was above or at 75, otherwise if <75 keeps current HP. Clearing this effect does not reset their AHP nor HP maximum.
- `FocusedVision`: FocusedVision.
- `AnomalousRegeneration`: If the affected player has a maximum hume shield, this sets the hume shield to the maximum value.
- `AnomalousTarget`: Allows SCPs to see the affected player from a certain distance. Works on SCPs.

entries.title: EXILED API: MirrorExtensions (part 2 of 2)
entries.text:
class `Exiled.API.Extensions.MirrorExtensions`: A set of extensions for Mirror Networking.
Members:
- `void ResyncEffectTo(this Player effectOwner, IEnumerable<Player> targets, EffectType effect)`: Resynchronizes a specific effect from the effect owner to the target players.
- `void SendFakeEffectTo(this Player effectOwner, IEnumerable<Player> targets, EffectType effect, byte intensity)`: Sends a fake effect to a list of target players, simulating the effect as if it originated from the effect owner.
- `void SendFakeEffectTo(this Player effectOwner, Player target, EffectType effect, byte intensity)`: Sends a fake effect to a target player, simulating the effect as if it originated from the effect owner.
- `void SetFakeSpectatable(Player target, Player viewer, bool isforceHidden)`: Makes a player not spectatable to another player.
- `void ResyncKeycardItem(CustomKeycardItem customKeycardItem)`: Makes the server resend a message to all clients updating a keycards details to current values.
- `void ResyncKeycardPickup(CustomKeycardPickup customKeycard)`: Makes the server resend a message to all clients updating a keycards details to current values.
- `void PlayCassieAnnouncement(this Player player, string words, bool makeHold = false, bool makeNoise = true, bool isSubtitles = false)`: Send CASSIE announcement that only Player can hear.
- `void MessageTranslated(this Player player, string words, string translation, string customSubtitles, bool makeHold = false, bool makeNoise = true, bool isSubtitles = true)`: Send CASSIE announcement with custom subtitles for translation that only Player can hear and see it.
- `void MoveNetworkIdentityObject(this Player player, NetworkIdentity identity, Vector3 pos)`: Moves object for the player.
- `void SendFakeSceneLoading(this Player player, ScenesType newSceneName)`: Sends to the player a Fake Change Scene.
- `void ChangeSceneToAllClients(ScenesType scene)`: Emulation of the method SCP:SL uses to change scene.
- `void ScaleNetworkIdentityObject(this Player player, NetworkIdentity identity, Vector3 scale)`: Scales an object for the specified player.
- `void MoveNetworkIdentityObject(this NetworkIdentity identity, Vector3 pos)`: Moves object for all the players.
- `void ScaleNetworkIdentityObject(this NetworkIdentity identity, Vector3 scale)`: Scales an object for all players.
- `void SendFakeSyncVar<T>(this Player target, NetworkIdentity behaviorOwner, Type targetType, string propertyName, T value)`: Send fake values to client's SyncVarAttribute.
- `void ResyncSyncVar(NetworkIdentity behaviorOwner, Type targetType, string propertyName)`: Force resync to client's SyncVarAttribute.
- `void SendFakeTargetRpc(Player target, NetworkIdentity behaviorOwner, Type targetType, string rpcName, params object[] values)`: Send fake values to client's ClientRpcAttribute.
- `void SendFakeSyncObject(Player target, NetworkIdentity behaviorOwner, Type targetType, Action<NetworkWriter> customAction)`: Send fake values to client's SyncObject.
- `void EditNetworkObject(NetworkIdentity identity, Action<NetworkIdentity> customAction)`: Edit NetworkIdentity's parameter and sync.
